title: What became of the Duconge brothers
summary: One brother is reportedly in Europe, another became a policeman in St. Louis, and Adolphe was killed in a car accident.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Oh, back to De Conge. What happened after you left De Conge's orchestra?

Those brothers? Well Pete, he went to, uh, Pete's supposed to be in Europe right now. And Albert, it was the last time I heard he was at St. Louis. But I heard he had given up playing music. He was a policeman up there. And Adolf Rooney got killed in an automobile accident. Come from playing.
